name: mern-users-app
description: Minimal MERN app — Express + Mongoose + Vite React — deployable on Azure App Service.

scripts.//: Kudu (App Service) runs npm install after upload -> postinstall builds React.
scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build && rm -rf server/public && cp -R client/dist server/public
scripts.//: Local dev — two commands, two terminals: backend + Vite dev server.
Single-server production start — Express serves server/public + /api routes.
